title: Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) — Effective Date and Charged Share of a To-Value Increase
content:
The day a to-value increase of an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy takes effect, and the share of the term it is charged for, depend on when in the term it is signed.

## Rule

For a to-value limit increase, and only for such an increase, the increase takes effect as of the term start when it is signed on or after the term start and no more than 30 days after it with no claim on the policy having a date of loss on or after the term start, and otherwise at 12:01 a.m. on the day the tier's standard waiting period in calendar days after the signed request and full payment are received.

The charged share of the term for an increase signed on or after the term start and no more than 30 days after it, where no claim on the policy has a date of loss on or after the term start, is one, the increase being made flat as of the term start and charged for the whole term; any other increase takes effect after the standard waiting period and, where that period ends before the term end, is charged the share of the term counted from the end of that period, never less than a minimum share of 60 days over the days of the term; where that period ends on or after the term end the share is nothing, the increase then belonging to the next term.

The standard waiting period is 30 calendar days on every tier. Days into the term are counted from the term start on the policy record to the day the increase is signed; the claim test reads the dates of loss of the claims reported on this excess policy.

## Combinations

| Signed | Claim with a date of loss on or after the term start | Takes effect | Charged share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 to 30 days after the term start | none | as of the term start | one (whole term) |
| 0 to 30 days after the term start | one or more | 12:01 a.m., 30 days after the signed request and full payment | days from then to the term end over the days of the term, at least 60 over the days of the term |
| later, waiting period ending before the term end | any | as above | as above |
| waiting period ending on or after the term end | any | — | nothing; the increase belongs to the next term |

## Boundaries (hypothetical 365-day term)

Signed on the 30th day after the term start with no such claim: flat, share one; signed on the 31st day: not flat. Signed with 200 days left: share 170 over 365. With 70 days left: 40 days remain after the waiting period, so the minimum applies and the share is 60 over 365; with 31 days left the share is also 60 over 365; with 30 days left the waiting period ends on the term end and the share is nothing.
